purpose: Teach: 彼女ら/これぞ/海域/空洞/戦記/歯止め/鉱物/噴出

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 女性社員、彼女ら、本当に、当社の、力強い、原動力になっているな、社員、男女、平等に、評価しろ、絶対に、本当に、頼むぞ、これは、当然のことだ。
lines.en: Our female staff — they're truly a powerful driving force for this company. Evaluate everyone equally, men and women both. I'm counting on you for this. It's only right.
lines.style: Direct, authoritative opening. Steady measured pace. Clear emphasis on 'equally' and the weight of the instruction. No softness — this is a directive stated as fact, not opinion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。これぞ、当社の伝統、と、社員に、誇りに、思ってもらえる文化、引き継いでまいります、本当に、お父さんから、頼まれた、伝統です、絶対に。
lines.en: Yes, sir. This is our company tradition, and I want the staff to feel proud of that culture. We'll carry it forward. It's truly a tradition my father entrusted to us. Absolutely.
lines.style: Respectful, measured, almost ceremonial. Slight weight on the word 'tradition.' Voice steady with quiet commitment. The rhythm of someone making an internal vow aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海域での、海運事業、新たな、市場として、検討する価値、本当に、ある、攻めの姿勢、見せていけ、本当に、頼むぞ、絶対に、急務だ。
lines.en: Our shipping operations in maritime zones — there's real value in exploring that as a new market. I need to see aggressive initiative from you on this. It's urgent.
lines.style: Crisp, forward-leaning. Decisive on 'aggressive.' Slight urgency climbing toward the end without raising volume — the tone of someone who sees opportunity and won't wait. Firm period on 'urgent.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い慣習の空洞化、社内、最近、感じております、新しい血、入れていきたい、社長、社員、活性化したいです、本当に、絶対に。
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've been noticing lately how our old practices have become hollow inside the company. I'd like to bring in fresh perspectives, invigorate the staff. It really is urgent.
lines.style: Thoughtful but energized. Slight hesitation before 'fresh perspectives' — he's thinking aloud, but then conviction returns. Building momentum toward the end. The tone of someone who sees problems and solutions simultaneously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者の戦記、社員教育で、必読書、扱っていけ、若手にも、創業精神、伝えていけ、絶対だ、本当に、頼んだ、絶対に、必ずだ。
lines.en: The founder's battle accounts — make sure those are required reading in our staff training. Pass on the founding spirit to the younger generation. This is non-negotiable. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Firm, almost solemn. Emphasis on 'required reading' — this is legacy work. Slower, deliberate pacing. The tone of someone entrusting something sacred, not just assigning a task.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コスト増加、歯止め、かける、対策、検討しております、本当に、急務、感じております、社員にも、ご協力、お願いしないと、本当に。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're looking at measures to put the brakes on cost increases. It's something I feel urgently needs to happen. We'll need everyone's cooperation on this.
lines.style: Careful, methodical. Slight strain underneath — he feels the pressure of the problem. Steady without urgency in the voice itself; the problem speaks for itself. Trailing slightly at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 鉱物資源の新規取引、新興国と、進めていけ、当社、グローバル戦略の、要だ、絶対に、急げ、本当に、頼んだ、これだけは、絶対に。
lines.en: New mineral resource contracts with emerging markets — push those forward. It's the cornerstone of our global strategy. We can't wait on this. I'm depending on you.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding, no negotiation. Quick tempo, almost clipped. The words 'cornerstone' and 'can't wait' land with weight. This is the priority of priorities — delivered with controlled intensity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のアイデア、噴出するように、出てきております、社内、本当に、活気、出ております、社長、感謝しております、本当に、皆、頑張ってくれています。
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our staff's ideas are flowing like we've never seen before. There's real energy in the company now. I'm grateful for that, and I thank you for it. Everyone is giving their best.
lines.style: Warm, genuine pride underneath the respect. Opening with brightness. Slight lift in the middle registers — he's genuinely pleased. The closing softens, almost intimate. The tone of someone who sees good things happening.
